import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def transform(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=bg]
    rows_=[r for r,_ in pts]; cols=[c for _,c in pts]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rows_),max(rows_),min(cols),max(cols)
    fill=2
    def fillrow(r,a,b):
        for c in range(a,b+1):
            if g[r][c]==bg: g[r][c]=fill
    def fillcol(c,a,b):
        for r in range(a,b+1):
            if g[r][c]==bg: g[r][c]=fill
    # horizontal: every row with >=1 mark strictly inside c0..c1, fill full span
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        full=sorted(c for rr,c in pts if rr==r)
        if any(c0<c<c1 for c in full) and len(full)>=2:
            fillrow(r,full[0],full[-1])
    # top/bottom edge rows fill full width
    fillrow(r0,c0,c1); fillrow(r1,c0,c1)
    # vertical: only edge columns
    fillcol(c0,r0,r1); fillcol(c1,r0,r1)
    return g

for k in ['Demo pair 1 input','Demo pair 2 input','Demo pair 3 input']:
    print(k, transform(G[k])==G[k.replace('input','output')])
out=transform(G['Test input'])
diff=[(r,c) for r in range(29) for c in range(23) if out[r][c]!=G['Test input'][r][c]]
print(diff, [out[r][c] for r,c in diff])
